name: Glassmorphism
when: Showing an app or digital product as calm, modern and premium: an app showcase, a feature tour, a product update, a dashboard. Best when real UI is the hero.
look: Frosted glass cards with thin light borders floating over soft drifting colour fields, real UI built in code, one card in focus at a time
pace: Smooth and unhurried: cards glide in with depth, the camera drifts, 2-3 s per card
